name: Lisinopril
indications: hypertension, heart failure, post-MI cardioprotection
description: Lisinopril is an ACE inhibitor used to treat high blood pressure, heart failure, and to improve survival after a heart attack. It works by relaxing blood vessels so blood can flow more easily.
side_effects: dry cough, dizziness, headache, hyperkalemia, angioedema
contraindications: pregnancy, bilateral renal artery stenosis, history of ACE-inhibitor angioedema

name: Amlodipine
indications: hypertension, chronic stable angina, coronary artery disease
description: Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels and increases blood and oxygen supply to the heart. Used for high blood pressure and chest pain.
side_effects: peripheral edema, flushing, palpitations, fatigue, dizziness
contraindications: severe aortic stenosis, cardiogenic shock

name: Metformin
indications: type 2 diabetes mellitus, prediabetes, polycystic ovary syndrome
description: Metformin is the first-line oral medication for type 2 diabetes. It lowers blood glucose by decreasing hepatic glucose production and improving insulin sensitivity.
side_effects: nausea, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, vitamin B12 deficiency, lactic acidosis (rare)
contraindications: severe renal impairment, metabolic acidosis, acute heart failure

name: Atorvastatin
indications: high cholesterol, cardiovascular disease prevention, hyperlipidemia
description: Atorvastatin is a statin that lowers LDL cholesterol and triglycerides while modestly raising HDL. Reduces risk of heart attack and stroke in high-risk patients.
side_effects: muscle pain, elevated liver enzymes, headache, joint pain, rare rhabdomyolysis
contraindications: active liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding

name: Sertraline
indications: major depressive disorder, panic disorder, PTSD, OCD, social anxiety disorder
description: Sertraline is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor used to treat depression and several anxiety disorders by increasing serotonin in the brain.
side_effects: nausea, insomnia, sexual dysfunction, sweating, dizziness, weight changes
contraindications: concurrent MAOI use, pimozide co-administration

name: Ibuprofen
indications: mild to moderate pain, fever, inflammation, headache, menstrual cramps, arthritis
description: Ibuprofen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug that reduces pain, fever, and inflammation by inhibiting cyclooxygenase enzymes.
side_effects: stomach upset, heartburn, GI bleeding, kidney impairment, hypertension
contraindications: peptic ulcer, severe heart failure, third-trimester pregnancy, aspirin-sensitive asthma

name: Acetaminophen
indications: mild to moderate pain, fever, headache, osteoarthritis pain
description: Acetaminophen relieves pain and reduces fever. It is the preferred analgesic when NSAIDs are contraindicated. Hepatotoxic in overdose.
side_effects: rare allergic reaction, hepatotoxicity in overdose, skin rash
contraindications: severe hepatic impairment, known hypersensitivity

name: Omeprazole
indications: GERD, peptic ulcer disease, H. pylori eradication, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, erosive esophagitis
description: Omeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor that decreases stomach acid production. Used for acid reflux, ulcers, and related GI conditions.
side_effects: headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vitamin B12 deficiency, increased fracture risk long-term
contraindications: known hypersensitivity, concurrent rilpivirine or nelfinavir

name: Levothyroxine
indications: hypothyroidism, thyroid hormone replacement, goiter, thyroid cancer suppression
description: Levothyroxine is a synthetic thyroid hormone used to treat underactive thyroid. Restores normal metabolic rate.
side_effects: palpitations, weight loss, insomnia, sweating, heat intolerance if overdosed
contraindications: untreated adrenal insufficiency, acute myocardial infarction, untreated thyrotoxicosis

name: Albuterol
indications: asthma, exercise-induced bronchospasm, COPD, acute bronchospasm
description: Albuterol is a fast-acting bronchodilator that relaxes airway smooth muscle for relief of bronchospasm in asthma and COPD.
side_effects: tremor, palpitations, headache, nervousness, throat irritation
contraindications: hypersensitivity to albuterol

name: Losartan
indications: hypertension, diabetic nephropathy, stroke prevention in left ventricular hypertrophy
description: Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker used to treat high blood pressure and protect the kidneys in type 2 diabetics with nephropathy.
side_effects: dizziness, hyperkalemia, fatigue, upper respiratory infection
contraindications: pregnancy, concurrent aliskiren in diabetics

name: Metoprolol
indications: hypertension, angina, heart failure, post-MI, atrial fibrillation rate control
description: Metoprolol is a cardioselective beta-blocker that lowers heart rate and blood pressure and reduces cardiac workload.
side_effects: fatigue, bradycardia, cold extremities, depression, bronchospasm at high doses
contraindications: severe bradycardia, second/third degree AV block, decompensated heart failure

name: Hydrochlorothiazide
indications: hypertension, edema from heart failure, mild fluid retention
description: Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that lowers blood pressure by increasing urinary sodium and water excretion.
side_effects: hypokalemia, hyperuricemia, hyperglycemia, photosensitivity, dizziness
contraindications: anuria, sulfonamide hypersensitivity

name: Gabapentin
indications: neuropathic pain, postherpetic neuralgia, partial seizures, restless legs syndrome
description: Gabapentin is used for nerve pain and as an adjunct anticonvulsant. Also helps restless legs syndrome and certain anxiety states.
side_effects: drowsiness, dizziness, peripheral edema, ataxia, weight gain
contraindications: known hypersensitivity

name: Fluoxetine
indications: major depressive disorder, bulimia nervosa, OCD, panic disorder, premenstrual dysphoric disorder
description: Fluoxetine is an SSRI antidepressant with a long half-life used for depression, OCD, bulimia, and PMDD.
side_effects: insomnia, nausea, sexual dysfunction, anxiety, weight loss
contraindications: MAOI use within 14 days, pimozide or thioridazine co-administration

name: Amoxicillin
indications: bacterial infections, otitis media, strep throat, sinusitis, urinary tract infection, H. pylori
description: Amoxicillin is a broad-spectrum penicillin-class antibiotic effective against many gram-positive and some gram-negative bacteria.
side_effects: diarrhea, rash, nausea, candidiasis, allergic reaction
contraindications: penicillin allergy, mononucleosis (rash risk)

name: Azithromycin
indications: respiratory tract infections, community-acquired pneumonia, chlamydia, otitis media
description: Azithromycin is a macrolide antibiotic with a long half-life often used for respiratory infections and sexually transmitted infections.
side_effects: diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, QT prolongation, hepatotoxicity
contraindications: history of cholestatic jaundice with prior macrolide use, severe hepatic impairment

name: Insulin Glargine
indications: type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes requiring insulin
description: Insulin glargine is a long-acting basal insulin analog providing 24-hour glycemic control with a relatively flat profile.
side_effects: hypoglycemia, injection site reaction, weight gain, lipodystrophy
contraindications: hypoglycemia, hypersensitivity to glargine

name: Warfarin
indications: atrial fibrillation, deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, mechanical heart valve
description: Warfarin is an oral anticoagulant that inhibits vitamin K-dependent clotting factors. Requires INR monitoring.
side_effects: bleeding, bruising, skin necrosis, hair loss, drug-food interactions
contraindications: pregnancy, active bleeding, severe hypertension, recent CNS surgery

name: Prednisone
indications: inflammatory conditions, autoimmune disorders, severe asthma exacerbation, allergic reactions, rheumatoid arthritis
description: Prednisone is a systemic corticosteroid with broad anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive effects.
side_effects: hyperglycemia, weight gain, mood changes, osteoporosis, immunosuppression, hypertension
contraindications: systemic fungal infection, live vaccine administration

name: Diphenhydramine
indications: allergic rhinitis, urticaria, insomnia (short-term), motion sickness, allergic reactions
description: Diphenhydramine is a first-generation H1 antihistamine used for allergies, mild insomnia, and motion sickness. Sedating.
side_effects: drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, urinary retention, confusion in elderly
contraindications: narrow-angle glaucoma, prostatic hypertrophy, MAOI use

name: Cetirizine
indications: seasonal allergic rhinitis, perennial allergies, chronic urticaria
description: Cetirizine is a second-generation antihistamine providing 24-hour allergy relief with minimal sedation versus older agents.
side_effects: mild drowsiness, dry mouth, headache, fatigue
contraindications: known hypersensitivity, end-stage renal disease

name: Pantoprazole
indications: GERD, erosive esophagitis, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
description: Pantoprazole is a proton pump inhibitor used for acid-related GI disorders. Available oral and IV.
side_effects: headache, diarrhea, abdominal pain, vitamin B12 deficiency, hypomagnesemia
contraindications: known hypersensitivity to substituted benzimidazoles

name: Furosemide
indications: edema in heart failure, pulmonary edema, hypertension, renal edema
description: Furosemide is a loop diuretic that produces rapid diuresis, used in heart failure exacerbations and edematous states.
side_effects: hypokalemia, dehydration, ototoxicity at high doses, hyperuricemia
contraindications: anuria, severe electrolyte depletion

name: Clopidogrel
indications: acute coronary syndrome, post-stent prevention, recent stroke, peripheral artery disease
description: Clopidogrel inhibits platelet aggregation by blocking the P2Y12 receptor. Used after stents and in ACS.
side_effects: bleeding, bruising, GI upset, rash, rare TTP
contraindications: active pathological bleeding, severe hepatic impairment

name: Citalopram
indications: major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders
description: Citalopram is an SSRI used primarily for depression. Dose-dependent QT prolongation warning above 40 mg/day.
side_effects: nausea, dry mouth, drowsiness, sweating, QT prolongation
contraindications: MAOI use, congenital long QT syndrome, concurrent pimozide

name: Tamsulosin
indications: benign prostatic hyperplasia, ureteral stones medical expulsive therapy
description: Tamsulosin relaxes smooth muscle in the prostate and bladder neck to improve urinary flow in BPH.
side_effects: dizziness, orthostatic hypotension, retrograde ejaculation, rhinitis
contraindications: known hypersensitivity, concurrent strong CYP3A4 inhibitors caution

name: Montelukast
indications: asthma maintenance, exercise-induced bronchospasm, allergic rhinitis
description: Montelukast blocks leukotriene receptors to reduce airway inflammation in asthma and allergic rhinitis.
side_effects: headache, abdominal pain, mood changes, behavioral effects (black box)
contraindications: known hypersensitivity

name: Hydroxyzine
indications: anxiety, pruritus, allergic conditions, preoperative sedation
description: Hydroxyzine is a sedating antihistamine used for anxiety, itching, and as a mild sedative.
side_effects: sedation, dry mouth, dizziness, QT prolongation at high doses
contraindications: early pregnancy, prolonged QT interval

name: Tramadol
indications: moderate to moderately severe pain
description: Tramadol is a centrally acting analgesic with weak mu-opioid agonism and serotonin/norepinephrine reuptake inhibition.
side_effects: nausea, dizziness, constipation, serotonin syndrome risk, seizures, dependence
contraindications: concurrent MAOI use, severe respiratory depression, acute alcohol intoxication, seizure disorder

name: Duloxetine
indications: major depressive disorder, generalized anxiety disorder, diabetic neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia, chronic musculoskeletal pain
description: Duloxetine is a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor used for depression, anxiety, and several chronic pain syndromes including diabetic neuropathy.
side_effects: nausea, dry mouth, somnolence, dizziness, hepatotoxicity, hypertension
contraindications: MAOI use, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma, severe hepatic impairment

name: Pregabalin
indications: diabetic peripheral neuropathy, postherpetic neuralgia, fibromyalgia, partial seizures
description: Pregabalin is similar to gabapentin and is used for neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia, and as an anticonvulsant.
side_effects: dizziness, somnolence, peripheral edema, weight gain, blurred vision
contraindications: known hypersensitivity

name: Rosuvastatin
indications: hyperlipidemia, atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease prevention
description: Rosuvastatin is a potent statin lowering LDL cholesterol and reducing cardiovascular events.
side_effects: muscle pain, elevated liver enzymes, headache, diabetes risk, rare rhabdomyolysis
contraindications: active liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding

name: Sitagliptin
indications: type 2 diabetes mellitus
description: Sitagliptin is a DPP-4 inhibitor that increases incretin levels to improve glycemic control in type 2 diabetes.
side_effects: upper respiratory infection, headache, pancreatitis (rare), joint pain
contraindications: history of severe hypersensitivity, type 1 diabetes, diabetic ketoacidosis

name: Empagliflozin
indications: type 2 diabetes, heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, chronic kidney disease
description: Empagliflozin lowers blood glucose by promoting urinary glucose excretion and has cardiovascular and renal protective benefits.
side_effects: urinary tract infection, genital mycotic infection, volume depletion, ketoacidosis
contraindications: severe renal impairment, type 1 diabetes, dialysis

name: Aspirin
indications: pain, fever, inflammation, cardiovascular event prevention (low dose), acute coronary syndrome
description: Aspirin is an NSAID and irreversible platelet inhibitor used for pain, fever, and at low dose for cardiovascular event prevention.
side_effects: GI bleeding, gastric ulcer, tinnitus, Reye's syndrome in children with viral illness
contraindications: children under 16 with viral illness, active bleeding, severe asthma, hemophilia

name: Loratadine
indications: seasonal allergic rhinitis, chronic urticaria
description: Loratadine is a non-sedating second-generation antihistamine for allergic rhinitis and chronic hives.
side_effects: headache, dry mouth, fatigue, occasional drowsiness
contraindications: known hypersensitivity

name: Escitalopram
indications: major depressive disorder, generalized anxiety disorder
description: Escitalopram is the active S-enantiomer of citalopram, used for depression and generalized anxiety disorder.
side_effects: nausea, insomnia, sexual dysfunction, drowsiness, sweating
contraindications: MAOI use, concurrent pimozide

name: Naproxen
indications: pain, inflammation, arthritis, menstrual cramps, gout
description: Naproxen is a longer-acting NSAID for pain and inflammation including arthritis and acute gout.
side_effects: stomach upset, GI bleeding, kidney impairment, hypertension, edema
contraindications: peptic ulcer, severe heart failure, third-trimester pregnancy

name: Methylphenidate
indications: attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, narcolepsy
description: Methylphenidate is a CNS stimulant used for ADHD and narcolepsy. Schedule II controlled substance.
side_effects: appetite loss, insomnia, increased heart rate, anxiety, dependence
contraindications: glaucoma, severe anxiety, recent MAOI use, hyperthyroidism
